meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 让应用快速接入 Matrix 聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里集成 Matrix 通讯渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Matrix chat channels to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Matrix messaging into your app

howto.what: Claude 会把 Matrix 适配器从 `channels` 分支复制进项目、注册并安装固定版本依赖、修好 ESM 导入，跑构建和注册测试；然后带你创建独立的机器人账号、写入连接凭据。
howto.when: 当你想让 NanoClaw 接入 Matrix 频道（支持任意 Matrix homeserver）时触发；若正在跑 `/setup`，装完回到该流程，否则用 `/manage-channels` 把频道接到 agent 组。

say.text: 帮我把 Matrix 频道加进 NanoClaw
say.note: 复制适配器、装依赖并跑构建与注册测试

say.text: 我的机器人在 matrix.org，帮我配置连接凭据
say.note: 引导创建独立机器人账号并写入 .env

say.text: 用 access token 方式配置 Matrix 机器人

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Matrix adapter from the `channels` branch, registers it, installs the pinned adapter package, patches its ESM imports, runs build and the registration test, then helps set up a separate bot account and credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a Matrix channel to NanoClaw (any Matrix homeserver). If you are mid-`/setup`, it returns to that flow; otherwise run `/manage-channels` to wire it up.

say_en.text: Add the Matrix channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, runs build and tests

say_en.text: My bot is on matrix.org — help me set up its credentials.
say_en.note: Walks through creating a separate bot account and writing .env

say_en.text: Configure the Matrix bot using an access token.
say_en.note: Uses Option B, sets only the access-token variables
